name: Merged human SFT to joint TH10, TH13 and TH17 PPO during TH12 controller repair
initialization: Restore the common-parent average of four 750-update human SFT specialists with a zero critic. Update all four shared controls. Reuse the original first-generation controller seed list with the new behavior policy. Every TRAIN credit must be newly played; original game RNG is uncontrolled.
controls: No geometry, aim, automatic shoot, automatic bomb, programmed movement route or Continue. Raw original 112x96 grayscale camera and preceding absolute-difference image. One categorical movement head and three independent focus, shot and bomb heads.
frozen: Eight fresh independent pairs per game and rank compare the original merged SFT to its own three-title PPO. Same host, lane, build and shared control interface within each held pair. No TH12 gradient, no geometric assistance or continues.
reward: TH10, TH12 and TH13 retain the previous validated native event rewards. TH17 uses -1 per lost life, +1 per genuine life gained, +2 on first native entry to each new stage, -0.03 only on same-life consumed Bomb stock, +0.001 per 60 previously unseen active native ticks if that clock is independently qualified. Without a qualified clock omit TH17 dense time reward from all arms, record that choice before the first TRAIN credit.
endpoints: Per-title, per-difficulty Stage 2 arrival and stocks at first arrival, terminal stocks, genuine casts, native script progress when qualified, and 95 percent uncertainty by paired seed. TH10 spends Power in place of a Bomb stock.
exclusion: No held or engineering credit contributes gradients. Do not impute completed credits or promote an unqualified title. At most 3 stages in these original trial builds.
training_comparison: Same first-generation budget of four on-policy credits per original work/rank, PPO hyperparameters, original native reward and rollout controls. Record actual hosts and control cadence for comparison to the earlier joint-SFT-initialized update.
training_trajectory_source: four-game-merged-online. The TH12 controller gap motivated this separate study. Use every registered physical TRAIN credit from the other three games. Shared physical trajectories count once across studies.
